source_policy: Every node and edge is traced from the official Menlyn Park 'LOWER FIRST LEVEL' map (first-party, https://www.menlynpark.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Lower-First-Level-Map.jpg). Positions were measured on a 1280×853 rendering of that image (native size unverified; ±0.6 % x / ±1.0 % y) and expressed as scale-invariant percentages on the 1000:620 MallMind plane (source padded 3.743 % of its width on each side). The sheet carries NO scale bar, so distance_unit is "px": no metres and no walking time are claimed anywhere. The Clicks storefront door is not depicted; the destination is the public-corridor point abreast of the Clicks frontage. Not an official Menlyn Park deployment. Not field-verified. Map artwork is NOT bundled (rights not yet confirmed); only the source URL and derived factual geometry are stored. See research/menlyn-spatial-poc/.
coordinate_system: percent-based MallMind node coordinates (0..100) on the prepared 1000:620 plane derived from the official Lower First Level map
notes: Tenant identity (Clicks = LF 72, nearest Entrance 13, Orange Parking, Atterbury Road) is FIRST_PARTY_EXPLICIT from https://www.menlynpark.co.za/stores/clicks/ (re-verified 2026-09-03). Spatial positions are FIRST_PARTY_VISUAL from the LF map. Edge length_px values are pixels on the 1280-wide rendering and serve only as shortest-path weights.
